payload.scope: T2 and inside-minus-outside are descriptive. Bootstrap-t95% intervals use1999 fixed draws; no family decision, coverage/power guarantee or inference over refitted predictors. Positive loss difference means worse intervention-effect prediction, not worse natural-answer quality. Vector energies are squared residual norms of the named arms.
